arguments.sql:
SELECT
    s.SOCType,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS matched_schools,
    COUNT(f."FRPM Count (K-12)") OVER () AS schools_with_meal_counts,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS meal_count,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
    ROUND(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", 6) AS stored_rate,
    ROUND(1.0 * f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0), 6) AS calculated_rate
FROM main.schools AS s
JOIN main.frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC, s.CDSCode
LIMIT 6;
